verdict.rationale: The evidence documents general payouts and mass disbursements to bank accounts or wallets. It does not document marketplace or platform features: no seller onboarding, no split payments between parties, and no per-seller payout routing tied to split transactions. Generic mass payouts are an adjacent disbursement feature, not the marketplace capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a marketplace or platform that onboards sellers, splits payments between parties, and pays out to each seller
